posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I've given some time for people to listen the episode so here an item that bothers me which is the reveal about how it is Glamour impersonating Ambuscade in the VotM deck. First and foremost, the incap clearly shows the face of Ambuscade which  seems odd if that deck isn't supposed to represent him leading that team.  Second, it has references to Freedom Five 702 which is referenced in Ambuscade's solo deck. The VotM deck has multiple references to the series The Deadliest Game which primarily follows Ambuscade. Artwork shows Ambuscade in situations, shrewd ambush, that don't make sense for an illusion to be doing. Then Glamour in the deck references Freedom Five 270. Lastly, the bio for the deck talk strictly about how Ambuscade formed the team. So even though a Slaughterhouse Six event occurs without Ambuscade that VotM deck doesn't represent that event very well.
